Concerns.Title: The Unfinished Composition
Concerns.Pitch: Stop there. No, there; the light has you now. The east composition has waited a season for its last piece. The piece is cast and the resin is spent, and a cast left open to the air turns the colour of old teeth. Two measures of pitchpod resin would finish it. Lacking resin, there is still the gap; it would hold a person for one evening. She has been watching how you hold your shoulders.
Concerns.Thanks: Finished. Do not look at it yet. Walk to the well, turn, and then look.

Approaches.Label: Bring two measures of pitchpod resin to seal the last piece.
Approaches.Objective: Bring the elder of Posy two measures of pitchpod resin

Approaches.Label: Stand in the composition yourself for an evening, placed where she wants you.
Approaches.Objective: Be held in the east composition for an evening
Approaches.OfferText: Stand where she places you, until the light goes

Refusal.Text: I won't finish it. I'm telling you so.
Refusal.Reply: Then it stays open. Some pieces are better open. Not this one, but some.
